packageRules.description: The Ubuntu image of yggdrasil.yml is 24.04 on purpose: the release the .deb's dependency names and the bundled libraries target. Digest updates still come through; a new major or minor (another Ubuntu release) is the owner's decision.

Dependabot watched only the application's pubspec (directory /). The vendored webview_cef fork is checked against its upstream release by tools/check-webview-cef-fork.sh, and the layering-rules plugin follows custom_lint's analyzer cap (see pubspec.yaml).

freezed 4 needs analyzer ^13, and analyzer here cannot pass 8 while custom_lint (0.8.1, its latest) requires analyzer ^8 (see pubspec.yaml's comment on freezed). Hold freezed and freezed_annotation below 4 until custom_lint ships a release on a newer analyzer; remove this rule then.
The workflow actions weekly and in one pull request, as Dependabot did.
